translations.web: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”
translations.bsb: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
translations.kjv: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
